settings.social_description: URLs for footer and social widget (Discord, Facebook, X, YouTube, Twitch, Instagram).

settings.theme_extras_description: Music dock (game themes) and navigation fallback when no menu items exist yet.
settings.theme_extras_link_hint: Manage active theme and colors under
